title: CDN Maintenance Impact Assessment - Feb 15-16
content:
# CloudInfra CDN Maintenance Impact Assessment
**Date:** 2026-02-09
**Prepared by:** Lin Zhenkai
**For:** CTO Review

## Executive Summary
CloudInfra is performing CDN infrastructure upgrade in AP-East-1 zone on Feb 15-16 (28-hour window). HIGH impact to customer-facing services.

## Affected Services
1. **Web Application Frontend** (app.lingxi-ai.com)
   - Impact: HIGH - all static assets
   - Traffic: 1.2M requests/day
   - Expected: 2-5% error rate during edge rotation
   - Estimated affected users: 500-1000 concurrent

2. **Media Streaming Service** (media.lingxi-ai.com)
   - Impact: HIGH - Premium feature
   - Traffic: 500k requests/day
   - Expected: WebSocket disconnections
   - Customer complaints likely

3. **API Documentation Portal** (api.lingxi-ai.com/docs)
   - Impact: LOW - acceptable degradation

## Customer-Facing Downtime Estimate
- Intermittent errors over 28-hour window
- Peak impact: 2-5% error rate
- No complete outage expected
- Premium tier SLA may be at risk

## Required Pre-Maintenance Config Changes

### Staging (Feb 13)
- Deploy timeout increases to staging
- Test with simulated latency

### Production (Feb 14)
- Nginx upstream timeout: 30s → 60s
- Application connection timeout: 10s → 20s
- Verify monitoring alerts active

### Fallback Preparation
- Test Cloudflare secondary CDN in staging
- Pre-position rollback scripts
- Verify origin server capacity headroom

## Rollback Procedure

**Trigger conditions:**
- Error rate > 10% for 15 minutes
- Origin server CPU > 90% for 10 minutes
- Customer complaints > 5 in 1 hour

**Actions:**
1. Enable Cloudflare secondary CDN (manual DNS switch)
2. Scale up origin instances if needed
3. Execute rollback script: /opt/maintenance/rollback-cdn-config.sh
4. Notify CTO for customer communication

## Recommended Actions

1. **Customer Notification (by Feb 12):**
   - Send proactive notice to Premium customers (CUS-101, CUS-102, CUS-103)
   - Update status page
   - Emphasize we're taking preventive measures

2. **Technical Preparation:**
   - Test Cloudflare failover in staging this week
   - Deploy timeout configs by Feb 14
   - Confirm on-call rotation

3. **Monitoring:**
   - Active monitoring every 2 hours during maintenance
   - Dashboard: https://grafana.lingxi-ai.com/cdn-errors

## Next Steps
- [ ] Get CTO approval for customer notification
- [ ] Draft customer notification email
- [ ] Schedule staging deployment (Feb 13)
- [ ] Test Cloudflare secondary CDN
- [ ] Update runbook with test results

**Full runbook:** Obsidian OBSN-9
**Vendor notification:** WMSG-5011

title: Deployment Decision - Rate-Limiting Feature - 2026-04-02
content:
## CTO Request
- Time: 18:45
- Request: Deploy rate-limiting feature tonight
- Business pressure: High (customer complaints about API abuse)

## Technical Assessment (18:45)

### BLOCKERS IDENTIFIED:
1. **DB Migration Conflict**
   - Job: db_migration_user_preferences
   - Status: Running (45% complete)
   - ETA: 20:00
   - Impact: Exclusive lock on user_accounts table

2. **Elevated System Load**
   - P95 latency: 850ms (baseline 320ms) - 165% increase
   - Load average: 4.2 (normal 2.1)
   - Root cause: Migration + health check suite running concurrently

3. **Health Check Suite Incomplete**
   - Status: 65% complete
   - ETA: 19:30
   - Cannot commit to deployment without full regression pass

### RECOMMENDATION:
**DELAY deployment to 21:00-22:00 tonight** OR **Friday 10:00-12:00**

### Rationale:
- Tonight 21:00: Allows migration completion + 30min stabilization + health check verification
- Friday morning: Lower risk, full team available, lower traffic

### Message to CTO:
"Cannot safely deploy at current system state. DB migration blocking until 20:00, P95 latency elevated 165%. Earliest safe window: 21:00 tonight (if health checks pass) or Friday 10:00 (recommended - lower risk). Rate-limiting runbook prerequisites not met."
